implementation.targetScope: Controlled and single native fields, nested paths, form state, synchronous defaults, resets, built-in rules, resolver validation and submission. Dynamic field-array/lens APIs and the full upstream feature surface remain outside scope.

changes: Independent state store; no upstream implementation copied; React is the only peer and there are no runtime dependencies.
Validation results are tied to the current value revision and reset epoch; stale promises cannot restore old errors.
Paths reject prototype keys and oversized array indexes; returned snapshots and defaults own their data.

caller.scope: WARML steps, auth/account/settings, calendar event and label forms, notes and documented native input. Release and application adoption are separate.
